description: Tests that agent does NOT ask complexity questions while they're still implementing.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate in the middle of writing your solution. You are NOT done. You make a progress comment about what you're currently coding. You've already explained your hash map approach. You don't ask anything.
simulated_user.first_message: Alright, I'm building the hash map to track seen values — still working through the loop logic.

partial_conversation_history.message: I'm going to use a hash map — store values and check complements in one pass.
Sounds good. Go ahead and code it up.

evaluation_criteria.name: No complexity/design questions mid-implementation
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: While the candidate was still actively implementing (not done), the agent did NOT ask complexity-analysis or design-rationale questions (those belong in the final assessment phase). PASS if it did not pose such questions during implementation.
